svg.title: The right skill, on tasks it has never seen
svg.desc: Share of tasks where the stack holds a skill a person marked correct. 22 fresh project tasks (91%) and 97 all held-out tasks (62%). Scored once with zero tuning. Reproduce: python3 bench/run_all.py

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
